anchor.name: Anchor Rune
anchor.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the cheapest rune in the game at 50g, and the pool's one plain armor-for-speed trade. It is also the entry ES §3 found a rarity rule had been HIDING a cost on — a real −10 Speed that the `scarred` schema forbade labelling because it was a Common.

glass.name: Glass Rune
glass.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only RUNE that writes `dmg_taken_bonus`, and the clause `Runes.PENALTY_FIELDS` exists for — a field where a POSITIVE number is the price. A talent node still writes the field, so the read site lives; what goes is the pool's one entry that charges in that shape, and with it the only live example `is_cost`'s positive-cost arm has.

reaper.name: Rune of the Reaper
reaper.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only execute window in the pool. `rune_execute_bonus` has no other writer anywhere — no talent node, no relic, no card — so its read site is the pool's one "finish the wounded" clause and nothing else can turn it on.

colossus.name: Rune of the Colossus
colossus.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only entry in the file whose WHOLE payload is max health. Six runes write `max_hp_pct` and four of them charge for it; of the two that pay it forward the other is a three-term splash, so this was the pool's one clean, unconditional "just be tougher" pick.

vampiric.name: Vampiric Rune
vampiric.desc: Attacks drink 10% of damage dealt as health — but heals received are 30% weaker.
vampiric.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only attack-lifesteal in the pool. `rune_lifesteal` has no other writer — the Occultist's Ruin leech is stack-gated and is a different mechanic — so sustain-by-hitting leaves the game with this entry.

old_wrath.name: Rune of Old Wrath
old_wrath.desc: He walks in already angry: battles begin with 20 Rage.
old_wrath.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only opening-resource grant the Warrior had, and the pool's one use of the bare `resource` field as a battle-start value rather than a cap.

warriors_edge.name: Rune of the Whetted Edge
warriors_edge.desc: Strike hits for +8% of Attack and builds 5 more Rage.
warriors_edge.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only item in the game that changes what a BASIC ATTACK builds rather than what it deals — `resource_gain` on Strike has no other writer, rune or node.

emberforged.name: Emberforged Rune
emberforged.desc: Strike burns as FIRE damage and hits for +5% of Attack.
emberforged.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: one of the pool's two damage-type conversions, and the Warrior's only route to elemental damage of any kind. `set: dmg_type` on Strike is a rewrite rather than an increment, and nothing else rewrites his basic.

wellspring.name: Rune of the Wellspring
wellspring.desc: Recover 5 more Mana at the start of each turn.
wellspring.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Mage's clean Mana-regen pick. `unquiet_mind` also writes `mana_regen_bonus` but writes it NEGATIVE as its price, so this was the only entry that paid the field forward.

reckless_channeling.name: Rune of Reckless Channeling
reckless_channeling.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Mage's damage-for-health trade, and one of the two entries pairing `dmg_bonus` with a cost.

comet.name: Rune of the Comet
comet.desc: Grants COMET: a crushing arcane blow (50% of Attack, 30 Mana, 3-turn cooldown).
comet.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: **THE LARGEST SINGLE LOSS IN THIS BATCH, AND IT IS NOT A CLAUSE.** COMET is defined INLINE in this entry's `new_ability` payload and exists nowhere else in the project — not in a draft pool, a boss pool, a talent tree or any spec's protected core. It is the only ability in the game reachable ONLY through a rune, so retiring this entry removes an ability from the game outright. The definition is KEPT here and is the only copy; deleting this entry would delete the ability.

new_ability.description:
A rune-called star falls on one enemy:
50% of Attack in arcane damage.

zealotry.name: Rune of Zealotry
zealotry.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Cleric's clean Smite amplifier, and the only writer of Smite's damage.

martyr.name: Rune of the Martyr
martyr.desc: Heals received are 15% stronger — but -8 Speed.
martyr.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the pool's only entry that makes heals RECEIVED stronger. The other three writers of `healing_received_mult` all push it negative as a price; this was the sole positive.

binding_souls.name: Rune of Binding Souls
binding_souls.desc: Grants SACRED RESOLVE: bind the heroes' souls, splitting all damage taken for 3 turns.
binding_souls.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: **the only rune that hands a hero a card from ANOTHER spec's pool.** Sacred Resolve is the Devout's draft and boss card, and this rune is class-wide — so it is the Holy Cleric's and the Occultist's only route to it. For the Devout himself it collides and `Run.apply_upgrades` pays Quickened instead, which is the shape CLAUDE.md records; for the other two it is a genuine out-of-pool grant and nothing replaces it.

true_flight.name: Rune of True Flight
true_flight.desc: Quick Shot hits for +8% of Attack.
true_flight.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Hunter's clean Quick Shot amplifier.

wolfs_hunger.name: Rune of the Wolf's Hunger
wolfs_hunger.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Hunter's damage-for-armor trade, and the pool's second `dmg_bonus` entry.

hoarfrost_points.name: Rune of Hoarfrost Points
hoarfrost_points.desc: Quick Shot flies frost-tipped: FROST damage, +5% of Attack.
hoarfrost_points.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the pool's other damage-type conversion, and the Hunter's only route to elemental damage. With `emberforged` retired beside it, NO reachable rune rewrites a basic attack's damage type any more.

exsanguination.name: Rune of Exsanguination
exsanguination.desc: Enemies bleed out at 85 buildup — but the bleedout tears only 15% of max health.
exsanguination.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the ONLY writer of `blood_pact`, and with it the entry `Runes.INVERTED_STAT_FIELDS` exists for. Its one field carries two behaviours at one read site — enemies bleed out at 85 instead of 100, and the bleedout tears 15% instead of 20% — which is why ES §3 had to name it as the cost that is a BEHAVIOUR rather than a term. That list now has no reachable member.

boiling_blood.name: Rune of Boiling Blood
boiling_blood.desc: Blood Frenzy grants +0.5% more damage for every 5% of health missing.
boiling_blood.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: one clause, and the thinnest loss of the twelve — `broad_path` already carries a Blood Frenzy term.

warpath.name: Rune of the Warpath
warpath.desc: Hack and Slash costs 5 less Rage and builds +5 Bleed on every cut that draws blood (its own 50% roll).
warpath.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only item that touches Hack and Slash, and the pool's one pairing of a Rage discount with a Bleed build on the same blow.

broad_path.name: Rune of the Broad Path
broad_path.desc: A little of every road: +5 Bleed on bleed-building blows, Blood Frenzy +0.25%/step, +15 max health.
broad_path.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Berserker's splash, and the only rune writing flat `max_hp` and `bleed_bonus`. Its Blood Frenzy step is shared only with `boiling_blood`, which EO already retired — so no obtainable RUNE writes that step any more; the talent node still pays its own half.

bared_guard.name: Rune of the Bared Guard
bared_guard.desc: Aggressive Stance deals +10% more — but Defensive Stance no longer reduces damage taken.
bared_guard.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the entry a standing rule in `CLAUDE.md` was written about, and the sharpest cost clause in the game: `rune_seasoned_def_bonus` −0.15 exactly cancels Defensive Stance's mitigation, and a talent node can buy 80% of that back. **The rule survives the rune** — it is about a rune that CHARGES, and EP ruled the refund is a decision rather than a defect. Both `rune_seasoned_off_bonus` and `rune_seasoned_def_bonus` lose their only writer.

still_wrist.name: Rune of the Still Wrist
still_wrist.desc: +4% Parry; a perfect Guard Change's parry buff is 5% stronger.
still_wrist.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_swordsmanship_parry` — the one item that sharpens a PERFECT Guard Change's reward rather than the parry rate itself.

shattered_guard.name: Rune of the Shattered Guard
shattered_guard.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Swordmaster's clean Break amplifier, and the largest single `rune_bd_bonus` in the file.

duelist.name: Rune of the Duelist
duelist.desc: A little of every art: +3% crit, +3% Parry, +10% Break damage.
duelist.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Swordmaster's splash — crit, Parry and Break damage in one object. Every one of its three terms is shared with a sibling, which is the splash shape working as authored; what is lost is the object, not a mechanic.

iron_promise.name: Rune of the Iron Promise
iron_promise.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Warden's Block-for-Speed trade, and one of two writers of `block_chance`.

grudges.name: Rune of Grudges
grudges.desc: +6% damage against enemies held by his taunt (stacks with the Grudge talent).
grudges.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_grudge_bonus` — the pool's one clause that reads whether the enemy is HELD by his taunt. Nothing else in the game pays for a successful taunt.

standard.name: Rune of the Standard
standard.desc: Allies take 3% less damage while he stands above half health (stacks with Shared Vigil).
standard.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_vigil_bonus`, and the pool's one clause that MITIGATES FOR ALLIES — two other runes heal them, none but this one reduces what they take. Nothing else in the game writes the field.

sentinel.name: Rune of the Sentinel
sentinel.desc: A little of every duty: +4% Block, +4% max health, +10% Break damage.
sentinel.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Warden's splash. Its terms are shared with siblings; what is lost is the object.

cinder_trail.name: Rune of the Cinder Trail
cinder_trail.desc: Fireball also sets one other enemy Burning for 1 turn, and Flamewave burns 1 turn longer.
cinder_trail.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_cinder_ember` and `rune_conflagration_ranks` — the one item that makes Fireball SPREAD to a second enemy, which is a shape no other rune or node has.

white_flame.name: Rune of the White Flame
white_flame.desc: Enemy resistance to his damage is 30% thinner and Inferno Master grants +1% per burning enemy — but -12% max health.
white_flame.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the ONLY writer of `rune_resist_pierce` in the game — the single item that thins enemy RESISTANCE rather than armor, and the only reason a fire-resistant warband is a different fight for a rune-wearing Pyromancer.

blast_radius.name: Rune of the Blast Radius
blast_radius.desc: Detonation consumes 25% more of the target's remaining Burn and gains +3% critical strike chance.
blast_radius.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `blast_radius_ranks` — the one item that changes how much of a target's remaining Burn a Detonation consumes.

long_burn.name: Rune of the Long Burn
long_burn.desc: A little of every fire: Burn ticks +1% of Attack, burning enemies hit him 2% softer, Detonation +3% crit.
long_burn.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Pyromancer's splash, and the only writer of `rune_accelerant_ranks` and `molten_ranks`. Unlike the other splashes this one carries two terms nothing else in the pool writes, so it is a splash by lane and a sole owner by field.

bitter_grip.name: Rune of the Bitter Grip
bitter_grip.desc: Every stack of Chilled slows 3% harder, and HELD enemies are 2% likelier to be struck critically — by anyone.
bitter_grip.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only item pairing Chilled's slow with a crit window on HELD enemies — the Deep Freeze lane's two halves in one object.

honed_lance.name: Rune of the Honed Lance
honed_lance.desc: Ice Lance costs 5 less Mana and drives 5% of Attack deeper.
honed_lance.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only item touching Ice Lance, and the Cryomancer's one cost-and-damage pairing on a single card.

killing_cold.name: Rune of the Killing Cold
killing_cold.desc: Enemies take 2% more damage per Chilled stack and Chilled enemies miss 5% more — but heals he receives are 25% weaker.
killing_cold.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_hypothermia_ranks` and `numbing_ranks` — the pool's one clause reading the Chilled STACK COUNT, and its one enemy-miss term. With `long_winter` retired at EO, no obtainable rune reads Chilled depth any more; the Hypothermia node still pays its half, and `numbing_ranks` has no other writer at all.

long_winter.name: Rune of the Long Winter
long_winter.desc: A little of every cold: Chilled slows 3% harder, Ice Lance +5% of Attack per stack, Chilled enemies hit 1% softer per stack.
long_winter.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: a splash across three cold terms. `killing_cold` still covers Chilled, so the loss is breadth rather than the engine.

resonant_core.name: Rune of the Resonant Core
resonant_core.desc: The first cast of each of his turns builds 1 extra Resonance, and the damage curve's step rises 0.5%.
resonant_core.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept: it stays here so a later batch can point something at it again, and it is never offered. LOST: the first-cast Resonance grant. `wide_current` pays crit and Mana and `seventh_bolt` a bolt; nothing else touches the BUILD RATE, which AT §3 measured as beating per-stack value quadratically.

seventh_bolt.name: Rune of the Seventh Bolt
seventh_bolt.desc: Arcane Barrage looses a seventh bolt.
seventh_bolt.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only item that adds a HIT to a multi-hit ability — `random_hits` on Arcane Barrage has no other writer, rune or node.

unquiet_mind.name: Rune of the Unquiet Mind
unquiet_mind.desc: Cooldowns tick an extra turn every sixth turn, and a fifth of Cannon's recoil is paid in Mana, not blood — but 8 less Mana a turn.
unquiet_mind.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `mindfulness_ranks` and `rune_feedback_ranks` — a global cooldown tick and the one clause that converts Cannon's recoil from health into Mana. Both are mechanics rather than magnitudes.

wide_current.name: Rune of the Wide Current
wide_current.desc: A little of every current: +1% crit per stack; every third crit hits 20% harder and swells his maximum Mana 10%; surviving a blow under 25% health grants a stack.
wide_current.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Arcanist's splash, and the sole writer of `arcane_mastery_ranks`, `critical_mass_ranks` and `rune_on_edge_ranks` — three separate Resonance mechanics in one object. It is the widest surviving payload in the file and the loss is three clauses, not one.

triage_ward.name: Rune of the Triage Ward
triage_ward.desc: Her instant heals can critically strike and mend 3% harder, and 5% of her overhealing is stored for the next Heal.
triage_ward.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `capacitor_ranks` — the one item that STORES overhealing for the next Heal, and a field no node writes. Its `rune_triage_heal` half was shared only with `open_hand`, retired at EO, so the rune side of that field loses its last writer too.

last_rites.name: Rune of the Last Rites
last_rites.desc: She already knows Resurrection, so this hones it instead: the rite comes back 2 turns sooner.
last_rites.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the one entry in the file that can NEVER grant. Resurrection is the Holy Cleric's PROTECTED CORE, so the payload always collides and `Run.apply_upgrades` always pays Quickened — which is why its `desc` is the only honest "she already knows it" wording in the pool. It is the worked example CLAUDE.md's collision rule points at, and the rule outlives the rune.

sleepless_vigil.name: Rune of the Sleepless Vigil
sleepless_vigil.desc: The most wounded ally heals 2% as her turn ends; allies under a quarter heal 5% as it starts — but -10 Speed.
sleepless_vigil.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_divine_presence_pct` and `beacon_ranks` — two separate per-turn heals on one object, one at her turn's end and one at its start. EN gave `rune_divine_presence_pct` a field of its own precisely so this rune could not go silently DEAD; it goes deliberately QUIET instead, which is a different thing and the distinction is the point of keeping the entry.

open_hand.name: Rune of the Open Hand
open_hand.desc: A little of every grace: +3% healing and her instant heals can CRIT, she opens each battle holding 1 Mercy, and allies under a quarter heal 5% more.
open_hand.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: a splash of three graces. `triage_ward` covers the healing term and `sleepless_vigil` the wounded-ally term; the opening Mercy is the piece with no other home.

warded_robes.name: Rune of the Warded Robes
warded_robes.desc: Divine Shield turns 4% of what it absorbs into healing, and its holder wears +10% armor while it stands.
warded_robes.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: Divine Shield's absorb-to-healing conversion. `burning_censer` reflects and mends, but nothing else turns an absorb into a heal.

binding_oath.name: Rune of the Binding Oath
binding_oath.desc: The oath is sworn before the fight: the Devout opens each battle holding 1 Faith of his own, and a Faith release heals 5% more of the bearer's max health.
binding_oath.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `oath_opening` and `rune_faithful_step` — the one item that gives the Devout a Faith stack BEFORE the fight starts, which is a different question from how much a release pays.

burning_censer.name: Rune of the Burning Censer
burning_censer.desc: Consecrated Ground reflects 10% more and the reflection mends every hero for a fifth of it — but -12% max health.
burning_censer.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_righteous_step` and `rune_lifewell_ranks` — the pool's one clause turning a REFLECT into an ALLY-WIDE heal. With `open_hand` retired at EO, no obtainable rune converts damage taken into healing for the others any more; the Lifewell node still pays its own half.

standing_vow.name: Rune of the Standing Vow
standing_vow.desc: A little of every vow: Divine Shield heals 4% of what it absorbs, -5% hero Break damage, holy ground mends 2% each turn.
standing_vow.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: a splash of three vows, and the one whose behaviour DO quietly narrowed (EM §5) — its holy-ground drip fires on Consecrated Ground alone. Retiring it closes that thread by removing it.

deepening_ruin.name: Rune of the Deepening Ruin
deepening_ruin.desc: Every stack of Ruin makes its bearer take 1% more damage, and anything bearing Ruin takes 5 Break damage at the start of its turn.
deepening_ruin.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: one of the two runes EN §1 re-keyed — its Entropy half is the per-turn Break tick EN gave a field to, so retiring it retires that field. It cannot be read apart from the Whispering Dark.

flayed_mind.name: Rune of the Flayed Mind
flayed_mind.desc: Grants MIND FLAY: 30% of Attack in shadow to two chosen enemies, leaving both Psychotic for 3 turns.
flayed_mind.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: a shortcut rather than an unlock, and this is the correction worth recording: Mind Flay sits in the Occultist's OWN spec draft pool and his OWN boss pool since DO, and he is the only hero who can buy this rune — so it never granted him a card from outside his pool, and when he has drafted it the payload collides and pays Honed instead. What is lost is the shortcut and the 160g price of skipping the draft.

hollow_chalice.name: Rune of the Hollow Chalice
hollow_chalice.desc: The Ruin lifesteal drinks 6% more per stack — but heals HE receives are 30% weaker (capped at 40% of the damage dealt).
hollow_chalice.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_soul_leech_step` and `rune_gluttony_ranks` — the Occultist's Ruin-stack lifesteal depth and its cap. With `whispering_dark` retired at EO, this was the last rune reading the Ruin engine at all; the nodes still pay their halves.

whispering_dark.name: Rune of the Whispering Dark
whispering_dark.desc: A little of every rite: +5% Break damage, each mark of Ruin has a 15% chance to leap to another enemy, which catches 1 Ruin, enemy afflictions mend the heroes each turn.
whispering_dark.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the other of EN §1's two. Four clauses, the widest payload in the game, and the case EM and DP both used as the worked example of a rune going silently dead.

deep_bond.name: Rune of the Deep Bond
deep_bond.desc: Every Loyalty stack drives the companion 1.5% harder, and deepens the Pack Bond boon by a further 3%.
deep_bond.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_absolute_step`. Its Loyalty half is shared with `shared_wild`; the Pack Bond deepening is not, and EQ and ER both measured against it — see §4 on the three re-authors this retirement makes moot.

turning_pack.name: Rune of the Turning Pack
turning_pack.desc: Swap Companion returns a turn sooner, and each different companion fielded this fight adds +8% companion damage.
turning_pack.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_quick_whistle_ranks` — the one item that shortens Swap Companion's cooldown, which is the clause that decides whether a second companion is reachable inside one fight.

loosened_straps.name: Rune of the Loosened Straps
loosened_straps.desc: Quick Shot flies 12% of Attack harder — but he sheds 8% armor, and every companion he calls wears his plate.
loosened_straps.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_masters_aim_ranks`, and the pool's one clause whose COST is inherited by the companions — the armor he sheds is worn by every companion he calls. Nothing else in the game prices a hero's drawback onto his summons.

shared_wild.name: Rune of the Shared Wild
shared_wild.desc: A little of every bond: +1.5% companion damage per Loyalty stack, +8% per different companion fielded, +5% companion health.
shared_wild.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Beastmaster's splash, and the only writer of `rune_companion_hp_pct` — the one item touching companion HEALTH rather than companion damage.

deep_sight.name: Rune of the Deep Sight
deep_sight.desc: His patience turns into force 8 Focus sooner, and critical hits pour 20 more into it.
deep_sight.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Focus conversion POINT moving — the one item that changes WHEN his patience converts rather than how much it pays. `level_aim` and `long_draw` both pay Focus; neither moves the point.

narrow_gap.name: Rune of the Narrow Gap
narrow_gap.desc: His arrows ignore 8% more armor and bite 12% deeper into Broken enemies.
narrow_gap.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Sharpshooter's armor-and-Broken pairing. Both terms are shared with `level_aim`, so what is lost is the concentrated version rather than either mechanic.

long_draw.name: Rune of the Long Draw
long_draw.desc: He opens every fight holding 60 more Focus and gathers 10 more per attack — but the draw is slow: -10 Speed.
long_draw.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_opening_volley` — the one item that opens a fight with Focus already banked, which is a different lever from the per-attack gather it is paired with. EM gave this field its own name for the same reason `rune_divine_presence_pct` got one.

level_aim.name: Rune of the Level Aim
level_aim.desc: A little of every angle: 4% more armor ignored, +10 Focus per attack, +12% damage against Broken enemies.
level_aim.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the Sharpshooter's splash. All three terms are shared with siblings; what is lost is the object.

weeping_wound.name: Rune of the Weeping Wound
weeping_wound.desc: His basic attack leaves Poison AND Cripple behind for 2 turns, and every stack bites 2 harder.
weeping_wound.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only item that changes what his BASIC ATTACK leaves behind. Nothing else in his pool touches the basic.

quick_spring.name: Rune of the Quick Spring
quick_spring.desc: Snare Trap costs 5 less Mana and comes back a turn sooner.
quick_spring.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only item touching Snare Trap, and the ONE entry in the file that the power arm cannot speak for at all — both its terms are INVERTED ability fields, so `DOD_SIM_RUNE_POWER` leaves it wholly unscaled by design.

carrion_wake.name: Rune of the Carrion Wake
carrion_wake.desc: He strikes 30% harder at anything wearing three afflictions and drinks 16% max Mana from every death — but -12% max health.
carrion_wake.retired: RETIRED at BATCH ET §1 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: the only writer of `rune_vulture` and `rune_scavenger_ranks` — the pool's one clause reading how MANY afflictions a target wears, and its one Mana-on-kill term. With `long_hunt` retired at EO, no obtainable rune reads the affliction COUNT any more; the Vulture node still pays its half.

long_hunt.name: Rune of the Long Hunt
long_hunt.desc: A little of every trick: +1 Poison damage per stack, +15% trap damage, Tripwire answers with 10% more of his Attack.
long_hunt.retired: RETIRED at BATCH EO §3 — kept, and said to be kept. LOST: a splash across poison, traps and Tripwire. `carrion_wake` covers afflictions and `quick_spring` traps.

deepening_hex.name: Deepening Hex
deepening_hex.desc: Ruin detonates every 8th stack instead of every 10th — while at least HALF his drafted cards are DEBUFF.

standing_mark.name: Standing Mark
standing_mark.desc: Ruin's lifesteal cap rises from 40% to 60%.

split_tongue.name: Split Tongue
split_tongue.desc: Hex of Ruin curses the WHOLE line rather than three chosen enemies — at 12% of Attack a target instead of 20%, and 1 Ruin instead of 2.

wide_rite.name: Wide Rite
wide_rite.desc: Every debuff he applies marks 1 MORE Ruin — while NO tag holds more than a THIRD of his drafted cards.

open_wound.name: Open Wound
open_wound.desc: Shadowrend marks Ruin on EVERY enemy, not one — but Ruin now decays by 1 each turn.

standing_wall.name: Standing Wall
standing_wall.desc: A block HALVES the Heavy Plating bonus instead of clearing it.

bracing_line.name: Bracing Line
bracing_line.desc: Allies take 5% less damage while his Heavy Plating bonus stands at +32% or higher — and while at least HALF his drafted cards are DEFENSE.

split_shield.name: Split Shield
split_shield.desc: Shieldwall is split in two: half its Block for him, and that same half for the ally he sets it in front of.

long_watch.name: Long Watch
long_watch.desc: His Break damage carries to a second enemy — while NO tag holds more than a THIRD of his drafted cards.

bared_plate.name: Bared Plate
bared_plate.desc: +25% Break damage — but he can no longer Block.

keen_focus.name: Keen Focus
keen_focus.desc: A target switch HALVES his Focus instead of clearing it.

heavy_bolts.name: Heavy Bolts
heavy_bolts.desc: His patience turns into force at 80 Focus rather than 100 — while at least HALF his drafted cards are MARK.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.desc: Called Volley strikes 0.5% harder for every point of Focus he is holding, and still does not clear it.

wide_watch.name: Wide Watch
wide_watch.desc: Focus carries in FULL through a kill rather than the 50 retained — while NO tag holds more than a THIRD of his drafted cards.

long_draw_press.name: Long Draw
long_draw_press.desc: His basic attack runs one EXTRA press at every stage — but the added press buys no widening, so the sequence is harder to hold.

long_leash.name: Long Leash
long_leash.desc: The Loyalty split point moves from 8 to 11 — three more stacks buy the companion's strike step before the boon takes over.

shared_hide.name: Shared Hide
shared_hide.desc: The companion's blows finally read the damage buffs it is already wearing — and the two the hunter carries for a bond that broke.

answering_pack.name: Answering Pack
answering_pack.desc: Once a fight, the deepest bond takes the blow that would fell the hunter — while at least HALF his drafted cards are DEFENSE.

second_whistle.name: Second Whistle
second_whistle.desc: Summon Ursus, Canis and Aguila each field the companion with 3 Loyalty already earned.

shared_scent.name: Shared Scent
shared_scent.desc: A fallen companion's Loyalty carries to the next one called — while NO tag holds more than a THIRD of his drafted cards.

bared_fang.name: Bared Fang
bared_fang.desc: +30% companion damage — but the companion can no longer be healed.
